body:
Filing gate: main-red anchor (convention ②: one failing check, one anchor card). The check is `Bundle Analysis` (`.github/workflows/performance-budget.yml`) on objectui `main`. Filed by the seat whose PR tipped it, which owns the fix-forward.

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU`, account `os-bill`), who also claims it in the next comment. Part of the fallout of objectui#11931 (`Part of #11861`, the validation-rule entry). The p0 grade is because `Bundle Analysis` is now red on every open objectui PR's merge ref, so no seat's lander can see a green head. Triage may re-grade.

Dedupe: open objectui issues created since 2026-10-08T08:40Z were listed: only objectui#11933, which is unrelated. objectui#11798 is closed, ruled A (`6054102412`, the maintainer's 「11798  同意」). Its ruling says that when the eager-closure headroom is spent, the work is done in objectui#6795's order: registries observable and readers migrated first, lazy loading second. That trigger has now fired, and the follow-up is filed to triage as its own card.

This card is only the red check.

## What happens (measured)

| `main` commit | what landed | `Bundle Analysis` (push) | eager closure |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `f1781be` | objectui#11929 (record page: refused read vs not-found) | ✅ success, job `113219913073` | under the ceiling |
| `19a7348` | objectui#11931 (Studio validation presets) | ❌ failure, job `113226826039` | **3307.0 KB**, "0.0 KB over the 3307.0 KB budget" |

- Ceiling: `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES = 3_386_364` (`scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs:1009`). It is over by fewer than 50 bytes.
- The per-chunk ceilings, chunk membership and freshness all pass. Only the aggregate is over.
- Each PR was green on its own merge ref. The budget bot read objectui#11929 at **3306.3 KB** (07:55Z) and objectui#11931 at **3306.6 KB** (08:10Z), both against an older `main`. Together they cross the ceiling.
- `Bundle Analysis` is not a required check and does not run in the merge group, so the queue admitted the pair.
- The same failure is already on objectui#11934's merge ref (job `113227249417`, 3307.0 KB). Its own delta, measured locally, is −2 gzip bytes.

objectui#11931 changes only Studio code (`ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`, a module-private `validationPresets.ts`) and 12 rows, en and zh, in app-shell's designer table (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`). Studio's route is lazy. So eager growth from it means the designer table, or something it reaches, sits in the eager closure. That was read from source; it is not yet measured per module.

## Done when

- `Bundle Analysis` is green on `main` again, by a fix that respects the ruling objectui#6795 records (lazy loading is second, and it reopens when the headroom is exhausted).
- ⛔ `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` is not raised to get a green check. Ruling A on objectui#11798 names objectui#6795's order as the answer to a spent headroom, not a higher ceiling.
- Acceptable fix-forwards, in order:
  1. close an eager leak that 11931's bytes ride on (Studio-only code or strings reached statically from an eager entry), without widening a published surface;
  2. failing that, revert objectui#11931 (the breaking commit's own revert) and reopen objectui#11861's validation entry until the objectui#6795-order work makes room.
